title: Discover Context Schema
description: Broadcast on app channel `fdc3.discoverability` to ask for the JSON Schema that defines a given context `type`. Reply is `fdc3.discoverability.contextSchema`.

contextType.title: Context type
contextType.description: FDC3 context `type` string whose JSON Schema should be returned, e.g. `fdc3.instrument` or `fdc3.data.markdown`.
